project_type: npm-workspaces TypeScript monorepo: React/Vite SPA (frontend), AWS Lambda handlers (backend), shared domain types (shared), AWS CDK (infra). Serverless MLB postseason summary + AI prediction site.
build_system: npm workspaces. Root scripts run per-workspace. npm is NOT on PATH by default in this sandbox: prepend PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" to every npm command. Node v22 local; Lambda targets Node 20.
test_framework: Vitest (unit, colocated *.test.ts). fast-check property tests named *.property.test.ts run under the same vitest command. Playwright e2e in frontend/e2e/*.spec.ts (headless chromium). infra has a CDK Template assertions test (infra/test/stack.test.ts).
build_command: PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npm run build  (ordered shared -> backend -> frontend -> infra)
test_command: PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npm test  (vitest across all workspaces). E2E: npm run test:e2e -w @mlb/frontend. Synth: npm run synth.
verification_instructions: 1) npm run build (must pass, ordered). 2) npm test (vitest: shared/backend incl. fast-check property tests, frontend, infra Template assertions). 3) npm run test:e2e -w @mlb/frontend (Playwright headless chromium --no-sandbox). 4) npm run synth (cdk synth, no AWS calls). All must stay green. Do NOT run cdk deploy. Do NOT make live Bedrock calls in tests (use the BedrockInvoker mock interface).
snapshot_or_generated_files: frontend/dist (built by vite build; CDK packages it at synth). infra/cdk.out (produced by synth). frontend/playwright-report and test-results/*.png (Playwright screenshots). No committed snapshot fixtures that must be regenerated.
setup_instructions: node_modules already installed in all workspaces. If adding deps (react-router-dom for #3), run: PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npm install <pkg> -w @mlb/frontend  (updates package.json + root package-lock). i18n is implemented as a lightweight in-repo React context layer (NO new dependency) to keep the bundle small.
environment_constraints: AWS creds active this session but DO NOT run cdk deploy and DO NOT make live Bedrock calls in tests. Network: assume package registry access is available for the single react-router-dom add; if npm install for router fails due to network, fall back to a minimal in-repo hash/history router and note it. CloudFront already rewrites 403/404 -> /index.html with responseHttpStatus 200 (infra/lib/mlb-postseason-stack.ts errorResponses), so BrowserRouter (history mode) deep links already work after deploy; no infra change required for routing, but add an infra assertion if helpful.
contribution_requirements: Steering files are inclusion:always and govern: incremental coherent commits per feature; spec-driven dev (keep .kiro/specs/mlb-postseason/{requirements,design,tasks}.md truthful to the implementation - this is a graded Kiro University lesson); testing is first-class (unit + fast-check property + Playwright e2e all green). Domain types live ONLY in @mlb/shared (never duplicate). Files kebab-case.ts for modules, PascalCase.tsx for React components. Do NOT regress the Bedrock default model id us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0 or its cross-region invoke IAM. Stay on branch feat/mlb-postseason-site. Do NOT push, open PRs, or touch GitHub (orchestrator owns publishing + redeploy).
key_patterns: Season logic in shared/src/season.ts (CURRENT_YEAR=2026, SELECTABLE_SEASONS=[2026,2025,2024], seasonMode/isResultsOnly/isPredictable). PredictionResponse is a discriminated union in shared/src/types.ts (mode:'prediction'|'results'|'upcoming'), always HTTP 200, frontend branches on mode. predict() in backend/src/predict/model.ts is a PURE deterministic function predict(series, bracket, winPct) with PROGRESS_WEIGHT=0.7, STRENGTH_WEIGHT=0.3, HOME_FIELD_EDGE=0.02, clamp [0.5,0.95]. BracketService.getPrediction orchestrates: results-only short-circuit, resolveSeries, hasStartedSeries guard, predict + generateNarrative. Frontend SPA currently has NO router: App.tsx renders one page (BracketView + StandingsPanel + PredictionPanel). SeriesCard ALWAYS renders the inline <ol class=series-card__games> game list (cause of uneven 'gatagata' card heights). Team names resolve via TEAMS[id]?.name ?? `Team ${id}` in SeriesCard.tsx, PredictionPanel.tsx, and backend predict/model.ts teamName(). styles.css: .bracket__grid is a CSS grid repeat(N,1fr); media queries at 860px (2-col) and 560px (1-col mobile).
